description: Retrieve U.S. congressional roll call votes and individual member voting positions for either chamber. Set 'chamber' to 'house' (default, from the Congress.gov API — Congress.gov publishes House roll call votes from the 115th Congress (2017) onward) or 'senate' (from the Senate's official LIS feed — the Senate publishes roll call votes from the 101st Congress (1989) onward). When the LIS feed can't be read (senate.gov refuses automated requests), Senate calls are answered from Voteview's published vote files instead, and 'source' names Voteview and its latest vote; a later vote is not found until Voteview adds it. Use 'list' to find votes by congress and session (newest first by default), 'get' for vote details (question, result, tallies, party breakdown, associated bill/nomination/amendment), or 'members' for how each member voted. 'members' narrows the roster by bioguideId (House only), stateCode, and party before paging, so one member's or one delegation's position takes one call. A bill action that records a roll call carries rollVote in congressgov_bill_lookup 'actions' — pass its chamber, congress, session, and voteNumber here. A House vote on an amendment carries amendmentType and amendmentNumber; pass them, with congress, to congressgov_amendment_lookup for the amendment's sponsor, actions, cosponsors, and text.

anyOf.description: A bioguide ID: one letter and six digits.

bioguideId.description: For 'members' on a House vote: return only the position of the member with this bioguide ID (e.g. 'J000298', as congressgov_member_lookup returns it), in any letter case. The Senate's LIS feed identifies senators by its own IDs, so a Senate 'members' call rejects it — filter by stateCode instead. Ignored by 'list' and 'get'.

chamber.description: Chamber whose votes to query, in any letter case. 'house' (default) draws from the Congress.gov API; 'senate' draws from the Senate's official LIS roll-call feed, or from Voteview's published vote files when that feed can't be read. Roll call numbers reset each session and are specific to one chamber.

order.description: Sort order for 'list', by roll call number in both chambers — the order votes were taken within a session. 'recent' (default) returns the session's latest vote first; 'oldest' starts at roll call 1. Ignored by 'get' and 'members'.

anyOf.description: A one- or two-letter party code.

party.description: For 'members': return only the positions of one party, by the code the roster carries (e.g. 'D', 'R', 'I'), in any letter case. Combined filters must all match; they apply before limit and offset, and pagination.count counts the matching positions. Ignored by 'list' and 'get'.

session.description: Session number (1 or 2). A congress's first year is session 1 and its second year session 2; a second session can run into January 1–3 of the following year (the 116th Congress's second session voted on 2021-01-01).

anyOf.description: A two-letter state or territory code.

stateCode.description: For 'members': return only the positions of one state's or territory's members, by two-letter code (e.g. 'WA'), in any letter case. Ignored by 'list' and 'get'.

voteNumber.description: Roll call vote number. Required for 'get' and 'members'.

name: congressgov_roll_votes

data.description: Result rows. Per-tool item shape is rendered in the markdown body.

items.description: Upstream JSON record. Per-tool item shape is rendered in the markdown body.

effectiveQuery.description: The browse scope and applied filters.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: A requested bill, member, committee, report, vote, or nomination does not exist in Congress.gov. `rate_limited`: A process-local attempt budget or the shared upstream credential/IP quota was reached; upstream hourly limits vary and DEMO_KEY also has a daily quota. On a Senate vote the LIS feed could not answer, Voteview answering HTTP 429 is reported the same way. `invalid_request`: Congress.gov rejected the request as malformed — a bad date range or an identifier with an unexpected shape. `api_key_rejected`: The api.data.gov gateway rejected the server's configured CONGRESS_API_KEY (missing, invalid, disabled, unauthorized, or unverified); the gateway code is in data.upstreamCode. No change to the call's arguments can fix it. `upstream_error`: Congress.gov returned an unexpected error (5xx or another non-2xx status) or could not be reached, or a Senate vote could be read from neither the Senate LIS feed nor its Voteview fallback (before the 101st Congress there is no fallback, and there a senate.gov HTTP 403 refusal carries retryable: false). `upstream_timeout`: A Congress.gov request or a congress.gov document fetch timed out or returned an HTTP timeout response, or the call's upstream requests could not finish inside its 50-second budget. `incompatible_identity`: A list operation carries an entity identifier that only a detail operation uses. `unsupported_filter`: A Senate 'members' call filters by bioguideId — the Senate's LIS roll call feed identifies senators by its own member IDs, never by bioguide ID. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

memberFilter.description: The filters a 'members' call applied to the vote's roster — a position is returned only when it matches every one. Absent when the call supplied none.

rosterCount.description: Member positions the vote records before filtering. pagination.count counts the ones the filters match.

notice.description: Guidance when results are empty, a page is past the end, or a caveat applies.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata: total count and next offset.

count.description: Total result count across all pages.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null when there are no more pages.

source.description: Present only on Senate calls the Senate's LIS feed could not answer (senate.gov refusing automated requests, or the feed unavailable), which Voteview's published vote files answered instead. Absent when the LIS feed answered.

citation.description: The citation Voteview asks its users to give.

congress.description: Congress the latest vote belongs to.

latestVote.description: Voteview's newest Senate roll call for this congress. Voteview adds votes after the Senate takes them, so a later vote is not found until it does.

date.description: Date of the latest vote, YYYY-MM-DD.

voteNumber.description: Roll call number of the latest vote.

title: Congress.gov Roll Votes
